minutes.headline: Bright Farms hearing continued to a Dec 7 special meeting; drawdown device waived; Howard St ANR swap returns Dec 14.
minutes.summary: The board waived the topographic plan for a Howard Street ANR lot swap, but questions about whether the earlier subdivision plan showed land the applicant did not own sent it back to Dec 14. The 361 Mass Ave (Bright Farms) hearing was continued to Dec 7 because the peer reviewer has not seen the latest plans, and the board waived the drawdown device for the infiltration basins. Committee reports, the stormwater bylaw's passage at town meeting and a Dec 28 subdivision-regulations workshop were also covered.

The land use director will tell the peer engineer that comment 36 (the drawdown device) was waived.
The Dec 28 workshop will turn to the subdivision rules and regulations instead of the common driveway bylaw.

what_happened.line: The Planning Board continued the Bright Farms hearing at 361 Mass Ave to a December 7 special meeting because the peer reviewer has not seen the latest plans.
The board waived the drawdown device requirement for the infiltration basins, and the land use director will tell the peer engineer.
The board waived the topographic plan requirement for the Howard Street lot swap (ANR), 4-0 by roll call.
The Howard Street swap returns December 14, with an extension to be signed, while the land use director researches who owned the land in the 2009 subdivision.
A December 28 workshop will take up the subdivision rules and regulations instead of the common driveway bylaw.

why_it_matters: The Bright Farms stormwater design, including how the infiltration basins are built, is still under review, and the waiver changes one condition the peer engineer had raised.
The Howard Street question of whether an earlier plan showed land the applicant did not own bears on lot lines for the two properties, and it stays unresolved until the ownership research is done.
watch_next: December 7 special meeting on Bright Farms, which rolls to December 14 if the peer review is not ready.
December 14 return of the Howard Street ANR plan, then the December 28 subdivision-regulations workshop.
